title: lucille-host --json: credential_ask
description: One ask of Lucille's for a credential, waiting for the user's answer on this computer: the service, the name and the hosts, laid out by the host, and Lucille's own words apart. Never a value.

title.description: What a person calls the service: GitHub, Gmail.

hosts.description: The only hosts the credential will be sent to: the service's template's, never Lucille's. At least one.

reason.description: Lucille's own words, to be shown apart, under "Lucille says:"; null when it sent none.

replaces.description: Whether a credential of that service and name is saved here now, which saving replaces.

value_words.description: What the value is, in the host's words.

make_at.description: The service's page where the user makes one, the narrowest it offers.

until.description: When the ask lapses, declined, unless answered.

ask_id.description: An ask's id: 16 digits of 0-9 and a-f.

service.description: A service the host has a template for.

name.description: A service's or a credential's name: 1 to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter or a digit.

host.description: A host a credential may be sent to: a DNS name of two labels or more, lowercase ASCII, no port, no IP address.

time.description: A time, UTC, ISO 8601, to the second.
